basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old gaming enthusiast from San Diego, California. I recently discovered Reddit and have been diving deep into the Rocket League community. When I'm not trading items or playing matches, I'm either cycling with my Peloton or learning about jewelry replicas. I work as a junior software developer at a local tech startup. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time, after work and gym sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained a strong understanding of Rocket League mechanics and item trading through online guides, YouTube tutorials, and active participation in Reddit discussions. Recently started exploring electronic music due to a growing interest in Porter Robinson's work.
